title: The Waltons
description: John-Boy challenges Olivia to take a night school course in art, but she gets more than she expected when the instructor kisses her.

title: The Waltons
description: Mary Ellen discovers a beautiful ring in a secondhand purse she bought for a date with John-Boy's best friend.

title: A Carol for Two
description: New to New York, talented singer Violette takes a job as a singing waitress. Things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

title: USS Christmas
description: Maddie, a reporter for a Norfolk newspaper, embarks on a Tiger Cruise during Christmastime where she meets a handsome naval officer and stumbles upon a mystery in the ship's archive room.

title: With Love, Christmas
description: When the office assignments are distributed for Secret Santa, Melanie is excited that she was given her crush, Donovan. Donovan is so taken by the thoughtful gifts and notes, he starts to fall in love. But someone else is stealing Melanie's credit.

title: Finding Father Christmas
description: Three days before Christmas, a woman who has never known her father receives a clue concerning his whereabouts. She follows the trail to a beautiful New England town where she meets a handsome young man willing to help with the search.

title: Engaging Father Christmas
description: Ian plans what he thinks is the perfect marriage proposal at a bucolic Vermont inn, but things do not go as planned.

title: Marrying Father Christmas
description: Miranda Chester has happily relocated to the Northeast, where she has established her interior design business. She splits her time between Boston and Carlton Heath, a picturesque Vermont town where her fiancé, Ian McAndrick, lives.

title: The Christmas Contest
description: Sparks fly between a former couple as they compete in a Christmas contest to win money for the charity of their choosing.

title: Christmas in Conway
description: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

title: The Christmas Doctor
description: A doctor encounters a man from her past who brings with him a revelation that could change her life forever.

title: Nantucket Noel
description: Tensions rise when a woman falls for the son of a developer who wants to tear down the wharf that is home to her toy store.

title: Christmas Joy
description: An ambitious market researcher returns home to care for her injured aunt. She's reunited with her former crush, now a hospital administrator.

title: Sound of Christmas
description: Lizzie, a young piano teacher, helps a school get ready for its major Christmas fundraiser, and she has committed much of her time to planning the event. When she meets Brad, who takes an interest in her piano skills, he asks if she will teach his uninterested teenage daughter to play the piano. She begins to break through to the girl, and sparks fly with Brad, but she is shocked to find out that his interest is not solely in her playing, but in the property that houses the music school.

title: 'Twas the Night Before Christmas
description: A former actress takes charge of a town's annual Christmas Eve courtroom production, in which the true authorship of the famous poem "A Visit From St. Nick" is debated.

title: Boyfriends of Christmas Past
description: Marketing executive Lauren must learn to open her heart with the help of four ghosts of ex-boyfriends who visit her leading up to Christmas.

title: A Christmas Duet
description: Fate brings an ex-music duo together over the holidays, just in time for the annual Yuletide Festival.

title: Sister Swap: Christmas in the City
description: Two sisters find a new sense of purpose and discover what they both truly need in life during the holidays.

title: Christmas at the Palace
description: Katie, a former professional ice skater, is hired by the king of San Senova, Alexander, to help his daughter in a Christmas ice skating performance. As Katie spends time in the castle, she and Alex begin to develop feelings for each other.

title: A Royal Corgi Christmas
description: The prince's Christmas gift for his mother, a corgi puppy, turns into a disaster when the dog misbehaves constantly. He turns to an American dog trainer for assistance and sparks begin to fly.

title: Christmas in Homestead
description: An actress heads to the Christmas-obsessed town of Homestead, Iowa, to shoot a holiday-themed movie. She is shocked when a romance blooms with Matt, a single dad. As she gets a taste of small-town life, she discovers the true meaning of Christmas.

title: A Holiday Spectacular
description: In 1958, an heiress puts her high-society wedding plans on hold to fulfill her secret dream of dancing in the Radio City Music Hall Christmas Spectacular.
